newsitem.title: USA: Exxon says restarts coker at Benecia, Calif.
newsitem.headline: Exxon says restarts coker at Benecia, Calif.

text.p: Exxon Corp said it restarted the 25,500 barrel-per-day (bpd) coker at its Benecia, Calif., refinery early Friday, following a maintenance shutdown that began in early February.
"It is up and running after turnaround...They're back up as of this morning," said an Exxon spokesman.
The plant, located east of San Francisco, has a crude capacity of 135,000 bpd.
The company spokesman said he did not know if the rest of the plant had returned from maintenance, but traders earlier this week said other shut equipment, including the crude unit, had returned.
